policies.text: Warranty extension eligibility requires a product defect frequency below 0.5 percent over twelve months.

Environmental labeling is granted if an item either demonstrates energy efficiency exceeding 90 percent along with recycled material content of at least 50 percent, or holds an active Nordic Swan certification.
Authorization for healthcare facility installation requires equipment to possess an FDA Class II clearance certificate.
Inclusion in the sustainable inventory catalog requires a product to be authorized under environmental labeling and maintain a safety compliance rating of at least 85 points.
Commercial retail distribution is approved when a device maintains an ingress protection rating of IP67 or higher.
